text: 创业板指跌超1%，沪指跌0.08%，深成指跌0.58%，算力硬件、半导体芯片、机器人等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股近2200只
text_en: ChiNext index drops over 1%, Shanghai composite down 0.08%, Shenzhen component down 0.58%; computing hardware, semiconductor chips, robotics among top decliners; nearly 2,200 stocks fall across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets
